title: Uncertainty-Based Offline Reinforcement Learning with Diversified Q-Ensemble

methods.one_paragraph_description: SAC with the clipped double-Q trick extended to N Q-networks: the Bellman target uses the minimum over N Q-function estimates (plus entropy term), which penalizes OOD actions in proportion to the ensemble's uncertainty (Eq. around line 166). Everything else is default rlkit SAC with 3-layer networks.
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: offline RL ("also known as batch RL", line 49); uncertainty-based Q-ensemble actor-critic

methods.one_paragraph_description: Ensemble-Diversified Actor Critic: SAC-N plus an ensemble gradient diversity regularizer weighted by eta that pushes the action-gradients of the N Q-networks apart, so far fewer Q-networks are needed to get the same uncertainty-based OOD penalization. Runtime: actor-critic with N Q-networks, min-over-ensemble target.
